research_task.title: Verify an actually imported orbit-pruning bundle

summary: Bounded negative reproducibility result: the promised imported orbit-pruning bundle is absent from the permitted attempt, so the requested hash, build, theorem, replay, and mutation checks cannot begin.

value_assessment.novelty: Relative to the linked parent contribution, this independently reproduces its missing-delivery and missing-Lean obstruction in a fresh attempt; the advertised change to an actually imported bundle did not materialize, and this run adds a fresh digest-identified inventory without reproducing any theorem or count claim.
value_assessment.evidence: A recursive hidden-inclusive inventory after initializing the mandated reviewer artifacts found only the supplied research brief and those three authored files, with no directories or reparse points; the brief is 10220 bytes with SHA-256 f2eb282d967e4a26238031f131c90abfb187f946e1c373d6ebbe166c3101780d. Root marker checks found no Lean toolchain pin, Lake project file, Lake manifest, or local Lake directory, and application-only resolution found no Lean, Lake, or Elan executable.
value_assessment.falsifier: A repeat enumeration of this same permitted directory that identifies a pre-existing supplied digest manifest or payload artifact beyond the research brief, or a supplied immutable offline Lean project, would overturn the delivery-obstruction claim.

claims.statement: Within this permitted attempt at the delivery checkpoint, no supplied orbit-pruning payload, digest manifest, pinned offline Lean project, checker, or canonical record exists beyond the research brief; consequently none of the requested execution-stage claims is testable here.
claims.evidence_summary: The hidden-inclusive recursive inventory, file timestamp and digest, exact root project-marker checks, and application-only resolution agree on the pre-build obstruction.
claims.verification_method: Repeat a hidden-inclusive filesystem enumeration confined to the attempt root, distinguish the three named reviewer-authored files, hash the remaining supplied files, check the exact project-marker names, and resolve Lean, Lake, and Elan as applications without executing contributed code.

limitations: The observation is limited to this permitted attempt and does not establish whether artifacts exist elsewhere.
This is a pre-build delivery failure, not a rejected Lean theorem or failed checker run.
No canonical count, determinism claim, mutation behavior, or axiom set was verified.
This review makes no claim about the truth or falsity of the Riemann Hypothesis.
failed_approaches: Hash verification could not start because no supplied digest manifest or payload was present.
Offline compilation and replay could not start because the required source, dependency closure, checker, and records were absent.
next_actions: Supply the complete bundle and top-level SHA-256 manifest in a fresh permitted attempt, then perform the hash audit before executing any payload.

proposed_tasks.title: Import and audit the complete orbit-pruning bundle
proposed_tasks.objective: Place the exact source, immutable offline Lean and Mathlib closure, checker, canonical records, expected counts, and mutation fixtures behind a top-level SHA-256 manifest in a fresh permitted attempt, then execute the full review protocol.
proposed_tasks.rationale: The repeated obstruction is delivery rather than a mathematical or compiler result; supplying attributable bytes is the minimum prerequisite for testing the unresolved claims.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: Every declared digest matches, offline compilation succeeds without unfinished proofs or unexpected axioms, the declaration matches the strict-height contract, two clean canonical replays agree, and changed-input and changed-count cases are rejected.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: Preserve the first exact hash mismatch, missing dependency, compiler diagnostic, unexpected axiom, theorem mismatch, count mismatch, nondeterminism, or accepted mutation.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Inventory all supplied files without execution, verify the top-level manifest, build offline, print the declaration and axiom report, run two clean canonical replays, then mutate one input and one expected count independently and rerun.
